items.title: AI and compute
items.summary: We’re releasing an analysis showing that since 2012, the amount of compute used in the largest AI training runs has been increasing exponentially with a 3.4-month doubling time (by comparison, Moore’s Law had a 2-year doubling period)[^footnote-correction]. Since 2012, this metric has grown by more than 300,000x (a 2-year doubling period would yield only a 7x increase). Improvements in compute have been a key compone
items.summaryZh: OpenAI发布分析报告指出，自2012年以来，大型AI训练任务的算力需求呈指数级增长，每3.4个月翻一番，远超摩尔定律的增长速度。这种算力投入的激增是AI性能提升的关键驱动力，预示着未来系统可能具备远超当前能力的潜力。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该分析揭示了AI训练算力需求的指数级增长趋势，对理解模型发展规律具有重要参考价值。
